title: Skill library repository configuration
description: Repository-specific values for the skill-library framework, read from .github/skill-library.config.yaml so framework files stay identical across repositories.

catalogUrl.description: Published catalog.json that the packaged skill bootstrap reads when no catalog is passed or set in SKILL_LIBRARY_CATALOG_URL.

pluginNamespace.description: Reverse-domain key under plugin.json extensions that records required and related skills in Agent Plugin packages.

catalogueDocument.description: Optional repository-relative Markdown page that must list every skill once at its current version.
